responsibility: On-demand translation of a non-preferred-language memory: original/translation toggle (US-DIS-002 AC-4), cache-first lookup via TranslationCache TTL=7d (AC-2/AC-5), Apple Translation fallback, confidence <0.7 keeps original + language label (AC-3), only triggered on detail expansion (AC-1)

inputs.memory: MemoryDetailModel with sourceLanguage != preferredLanguage (needsTranslation), originalText, translationVisible, translatedText, translationConfidence
inputs.translationService: TranslationService protocol (display-layer) — cache-first, Apple Translation fallback (🔮 Phase 3.9 real model)
inputs.translationCache: TranslationCache with TTL=7d, injectable clock for determinism

outputs.visibleContent: Original text, translation toggle button, translated text (when available and confidence >= 0.7), original text + language label (when confidence < 0.7), progress indicator while translating, L2 error toast + retry on failure
outputs.accessibilityTree: Toggle with value Original shown / Translation shown; translated body announced on completion

systemContainer: NavigationStack (memory detail push) + ScrollView content section + Alert/Toast for L2 retry
